headline:
Cheap on paper,
momentum still missing
chart_note: 52-week range: $190.12 - $370.86. Currently around $279.79, down roughly 18% over the past year despite steady growth.
why_today: Roughly flat recently, with earnings due September 10 - the market is largely waiting on that print before committing either direction.
pro_1: PEG around 0.6-1.0x is inexpensive for the growth rate, and a PE near 16x is well below typical software-sector norms
pro_2: Revenue up about 11% and EPS up about 13% YoY - steady, consistent growth rather than a slowdown
con_1: Analyst consensus has cooled to Hold, with the average price target roughly flat to slightly below the current price
con_2: Stock is down sharply over the past year and next earnings (Sep 10) is just days away - real event risk either direction
